capabilities: Generate index notes of wikilinks for a folder's notes
Generate glossary notes embedding folder notes with headers
Build combined overviews with anchor links to embedded sections
Sort and filter indexed files by time, name, extension, and empty folders
Format output with custom markdown templates and preserved frontmatter
extras: Generated files are tracked and excluded from later runs to avoid infinite loops when regenerating indexes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically generate and keep up to date a table-of-contents index or glossary of the notes in a folder.
summary: Generates index, glossary, or combined overview notes for a folder, listing wikilinks and embedding note contents with headings.
